title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: sponsored guest-pass allotment and per-pass fee by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's monthly allotment of complimentary Corporate Guest Pass day passes an employer may sponsor, and the fee charged per sponsored pass beyond that allotment.

| Tier | Complimentary sponsored guest passes per month | Fee per sponsored pass beyond the allotment |
|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | 0 | $15.00 |
| Small Business Partner | 2 | $12.00 |
| Mid-Market Partner | 5 | $10.00 |
| Enterprise Partner | 10 | $0.00 |
| Municipal Partner | 5 | $10.00 |
| Nonprofit Partner | 3 | $8.00 |

How this allotment and per-pass fee are applied to a sponsored guest pass is stated in a separate document.
